abstract: A twenty-year-old female, who had multi-agent chemotherapy for eighteen months after surgical resection of a choriocarcinoma originating from the left adnexa, was hospitalized because of a cerebrovascular accident. Her complaints were unconsciousness, generalized convulsion and left hemiparesis. Although both plain and contrast enhanced CT scans demonstrated only acute subdural hematoma in the right frontoparietal region associated with midline shift, no tumor shadow was recognized over the cortex or intraparenchymally. A carotid angiogram revealed a large and irregularly shaped aneurysm at a peripheral branching of the angular artery. Evacuation of the hematoma, resection of the aneurysm and revascularization for the defect of the parent artery by transplantation of a part of STA by means of microsurgical anastomosis were done at an emergency operation. Nevertheless the graft did not prove to be patent on the post-operative angiogram. Due to retrograde filling of the distal portion of the angular artery through collateral channels, the patient has been completely free of neurological deficit and her performance of daily activities has been excellent. No appearance of other intracranial metastasis of the tumor has been detected for six months thereafter. Histological examination of the resected aneurysm demonstrated that choriocarcinoma composed of cytotrophoblasts and syncitiotrophoblasts filled the lumen of the aneurysm. The van Gieson's staining clarified the invasion of the tumor into the vascular wall causing disruption of lamina elastica beneath the fairly intact adventitia. Microscopic findings of the specimens taken from adjacent brain tissue and overlying dura mater confirmed absence of metastatic lesion in them.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 20歳の女性が、左付属器由来の絨毛癌の外科的切除後、18か月間多剤併用化学療法を受けていた。脳血管障害のため入院した。意識障害、全身痙攣、左片麻痺を認めた。単純CTおよび造影CTでは右前頭頭頂部の急性硬膜下血腫と正中偏位のみが認められたが、皮質上または実質内に腫瘍影は認められなかった。頸動脈造影では角回動脈の末梢分岐部に大きく不規則な形状の動脈瘤が認められた。緊急手術では、血腫除去、動脈瘤切除、および顕微鏡下吻合による浅側頭動脈の一部移植による親動脈の欠損部の血行再建を行った。しかし術後血管造影で移植血管の開存は確認されなかった。側副路を介して角回動脈遠位部が逆行性に充満したため、患者は神経脱落症状なく、日常生活動作も非常に良好である。その後6か月間、腫瘍の他の頭蓋内転移は認められていない。切除した動脈瘤の組織学的検査では、細胞性栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞からなる絨毛癌が動脈瘤の内腔を満たしていた。ヴァンギーソン染色では、腫瘍が血管壁に浸潤し、ほぼ正常な外膜の下で弾性板の断裂を引き起こしていることが明らかになった。隣接する脳組織および上にある硬膜の標本の顕微鏡所見では、転移病変がないことが確認された。(抄録は250語で打ち切られている)
